### JOURNEY-005 — Role changes across journeys

- **Feature area:** Cross-feature journeys and recovery. **Test level:** browser E2E. **Implementation state:** server-backed. **Priority:** P1 — end-to-end consistency. **Status:** Proposed; awaiting execution.
- **Role / starting state / prerequisites / test data:** Separate synthetic Guest/User, Creator owner, second Creator and Admin fixtures. Creator owns Products; Admin changes that account to USER, then restores Creator.
- **Steps:** Reload home/navigation/profile, public storefront and owned management routes after new login.
- **Expected results:** Single-role UI access changes; public storefront requires Creator role; Products are not transferred/deleted by role change. Old-JWT timing is covered separately.
- **Required environment / external service:** Test frontend and backend with persistent test data; no external service unless specified.

title: Network interruption at persistence boundary
instructions:
### JOURNEY-007 — Network interruption at persistence boundary

- **Feature area:** Cross-feature journeys and recovery. **Test level:** browser E2E. **Implementation state:** server-backed. **Priority:** P1 — end-to-end consistency. **Status:** Proposed; awaiting execution.
- **Role / starting state / prerequisites / test data:** Separate synthetic Guest/User, Creator owner, second Creator and Admin fixtures. Unsaved Product edit, storefront draft and paid checkout in separate fixtures.
- **Steps:** Interrupt after request submission but before response; restore, reload server-backed resource and retry same operation/key.
- **Expected results:** Server reads establish actual commit state; retry checkout reuses idempotency; authoring cannot be assumed rolled back merely because response was lost.
- **Required environment / external service:** Test frontend and backend with persistent test data; no external service unless specified.

assessed: Normal Creator Product save responses were dropped after actual upstream200. Actual API/SQL and normal Overview reload show committed name. Back flush retries the identical request hash and succeeds200. Two same-payload requests lost responses before the manual retry; no duplicate Product.

Normal Storefront Light appearance save commits200, then response is dropped. Original tab shows Network Error/unsaved; separate fresh browser reload and API prove Light persisted. Same normal Save retry has identical payload hash and succeeds200.

Fresh real normal Product Add to Cart and distinct buyer sign-in establish one paid item and fake-only checkout. Proxy drains the actual committed201 and drops its response; normal error toast and Cart retention observed.
Authorized buyer orderGET200 and read-only PostgreSQL establish one PENDING100minor FAKE order, one item, one payment attempt and zero entitlements before retry.
Immediate normal Proceed to checkout sends the identical36-character key hash, returns the same201 body hash/order, then actual orderGET200; normal pending-payment toast and Cart retention observed.
Post-retry authorized API and read-onlySQL show exactly the same order/item/attempt and zero grants. Normal Remove clearsCart; ownerAPI hidesProduct200.
scope_audit.outcome: Fully assessed Pass: historical actual Product/Storefront commit-and-retry plus fresh complete fake-checkout response-loss/same-key retry fulfill the persistence-boundary case. Historical lost-runtime teardown remains a limitation, not an unexecuted assertion.

title: Unrelated-owner resource substitution
instructions:
### JOURNEY-008 — Unrelated-owner resource substitution

- **Feature area:** Cross-feature journeys and recovery. **Test level:** browser E2E. **Implementation state:** server-backed. **Priority:** P1 — end-to-end consistency. **Status:** Proposed; awaiting execution.
- **Role / starting state / prerequisites / test data:** Separate synthetic Guest/User, Creator owner, second Creator and Admin fixtures. Two Creators with Course/Download/Membership/config and customer/order records.
- **Steps:** Replace one path ID at a time with other owner's valid ID across authoring, download, landing, feed, customer and order calls.
- **Expected results:** Parent/owner/current-principal checks prevent cross-owner mutation/disclosure; Admin bypass only where explicitly implemented, never for Creator-only reports/config or foreign calendar disconnect.
- **Required environment / external service:** Test frontend and backend with persistent test data; no external service unless specified.

assessed: 72 labelled actual HTTP checks cover both Creator directions and Admin parent constraints for Product/sections/lessons, Download authoring/delivery, Membership config/content/feed, landing config, customer/order report scope, buyer-order access and foreign calendar disconnect. Valid CSRF prevents confusing role denial with CSRF denial.

All denied operations preserve exact original DB/read models; Admin controls permitted only for explicit Product/Membership/landing/buyer-order operations. Creator-only reports/config and foreign calendar deletion deny Admin.
Actual caller-ID injection changes only caller config; foreign config identical and caller settings restored.
Normal browser foreign landing GET/Save reject403; own customer control renders, foreign customer URL gives404/no foreign detail and own recovery works. UI error-handling defects tracked separately.
Saved foreign Course editor crashes with existing BUG-001 before normal authoring substitution can continue. API coverage is not substituted as a full browser mutation journey.

Setup uses direct historical reporting rows, inert calendar-shaped metadata and nonexistent Download object keys. Does not establish checkout/payment, live calendar connection or stored byte delivery.
remaining: Required complete browser authoring/file/feed substitution chain remains unexecuted; saved editor BUG-001 prevents it. Parent stays partial.
Provider/storage integration and real payment flow belong to their separate cases and remain unclaimed.
scope_audit.outcome: Partial: actual API matrix and selected browser denials assessed, full browser journey blocked by saved editor.

assessment_scope: Partial: actual API matrix and selected browser denials assessed, full browser journey blocked by saved editor.
